content.short: Backed Finance bridges the gap between traditional finance and DeFi through regulated tokenized real-world assets.
content.description: Backed Finance is a regulated Swiss platform that specializes in the tokenization of real-world assets (RWAs), such as stocks, ETFs, and corporate bonds. By issuing fully collateralized and transparent 'bTokens' on the blockchain, Backed enables users to gain 24/7 access to traditional financial instruments within a decentralized environment. Each token is backed 1:1 by the underlying asset held in custody by regulated institutions, ensuring full legal compliance and security. The protocol allows DeFi applications to integrate stable, yield-bearing assets from the traditional economy, fostering a more resilient and diversified digital asset ecosystem that connects global capital markets with the innovations of Web3.
content.meta: Backed Finance provides regulated tokenized real-world assets, enabling the seamless integration of traditional financial instruments into the DeFi ecosystem.
